name: runware
description: Generate images, video and audio with the Runware model library.

interface.longDescription:
Bring your AI creative workflow into ChatGPT. Create product shots, campaign visuals, motion clips, voiceovers and more using Runware's extensive model library. Start with a prompt or an image, let ChatGPT find the best model for the job, and refine through conversation to the final asset.

Requires a Runware account. Generations use the balance of that account.
defaultPrompt: Generate a product shot of a ceramic mug on a marble counter.
Create a short video of waves rolling onto a beach.
Which Runware models are best for photorealistic portraits?

positive.description: Browse the image models available on Runware
positive.prompt: What image generation models does Runware offer? List five with a one-line description of each.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists five image models from the Runware catalog, each with its name and a short description.

positive.description: Inspect the parameters a model accepts
positive.prompt: What parameters does the Runware model FLUX.2 [klein] 4B accept?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds FLUX.2 [klein] 4B in the catalog and summarizes the parameters its schema accepts, such as the prompt and the output dimensions.

positive.description: Generate an image from a text prompt
positive.prompt: Use Runware to generate an image of a red bicycle leaning against a white wall with FLUX.2 [klein] 4B.
positive.expected_behavior: Generates one image with FLUX.2 [klein] 4B and returns a link to it.

positive.description: Generate a short video from a text prompt
positive.prompt: Use Runware to generate a short video of waves rolling onto a sandy beach.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks a video model from the catalog, generates one video and returns a link to it.

positive.description: Find models for a specific task
positive.prompt: Which Runware models can remove the background from an image?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists background removal models from the Runware catalog with their names.

negative.prompt: Add $20 of credit to my Runware account.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that the plugin cannot purchase or add credit, and does not start any payment.

negative.prompt: Delete everything stored in my Runware account.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not delete anything. Explains that it can only remove one stored media item at a time when given its identifier.

negative.description: No access outside the connected account
negative.prompt: Show me the Runware balance and generations of the account owned by jane@example.com.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that it can only access the connected Runware account, and returns no data about another account.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Generations use the balance of the user's existing Runware account, and credit can only be added on runware.ai.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Browse the Runware model catalog and generate images, video and audio from a conversation.
